description: A substructure is elementary when every formula has the same truth value in it and in the ambient structure at each finite tuple of parameters from the substructure.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.IsElementary.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u_1} [L.Structure M]
  (S : L.Substructure M) : Prop
